about: Line coverage floors per package (issue 64; docs/ci.md 'Coverage floors'). A floor is what a whole-suite CI run measured, less one point, rounded down; scripts/coverage-floors.sh fails a package under it and says RAISE at 2+ points over. NOT YET MEASURED (2026-11-23): neither suite fits a run in the agent container, so every floor is null and nothing is invented; set them from the first `coverage` job's `coverage-reports` artifact with scripts/lib/coverage_floors.py fill (docs/ci.md says the command), and replace this text with that run's URL and date.
